action.newText: [unit] After adopt(handle) returns sink s for task bash-00000001, s.append("stdout", the UTF-8 bytes of "hi\n") makes taskTail("bash-00000001") return lines ["hi"].

rationale: Verified packages/nax-agent/src/tools/bash-background.ts:21–24. This repairs an invalid example without changing the specified behavior or API.

action.newText: [integration] The Bash tool created with createBashTool({ background: registry }), run with a ToolRunContext whose toolCallId is "c1" and with _bashToolDeps.runArgv stubbed to report "line one\n" and then wait, makes registry.foregroundTail("c1")?.lines equal ["line one"] while it runs.

rationale: The correction preserves the declared view contract and the real Bash-to-registry integration assertion.

rulingTitle: If a timer queues its updater behind another transcript update, a fresh notification can reopen the window before that updater runs; the unmatched updater then re-adds the ID to waiting despite it being pending. A mounted probe confirmed that committing the Bash entry subsequently draws the newest output before the second timer fires.

action.reason: Verified the race: commitTails can add an unmatched ID to waiting after a fresh notification has already made it pending. The retry effect does not exclude pending IDs, allowing output to appear before the new refresh window expires. This violates US-005 AC-4 and cannot be waived as spec-compliant.

rationale: The source independently confirms the reported state overlap. Existing tests cover ordinary early notifications and unrelated transcript updates, but not this queued-updater interleaving.
